candidates.snippet: Russian forces recently advanced in the Pokrovsk      direction and Kostyantynivka-Druzhkivka tactical area.

Ukrainian forces continued their long-range strike      campaign against oil infrastructure in Russia. Russia launched an unspecified number of Onyx anti-ship missiles and Iskander-M, S-400, and KN-23 ballistic missiles, 32 Kh-101 cruise missiles, and 166 drones against Ukraine
